title: ACME Corp Q4 2025 earnings call
text:
Operator: Welcome to the ACME Corp fourth quarter earnings call.

CEO: Revenue grew 18% year over year, driven by our cloud subscription segment. Gross margin expanded 220 basis points as component costs eased.

CFO: We are raising full-year guidance. Free cash flow was a record, and we repurchased 2 billion dollars of stock. Inventory days fell to 41.

Analyst: Can you talk about demand visibility into next year?

CEO: Backlog is at an all-time high. We see strong enterprise demand and pricing power, although we remain cautious about the consumer hardware segment, where unit volumes declined 4%.
